Summary: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
Login BRD v3.1 authentication for a Bank RM (userType BANK_RM, employee ID, bank AD-verify) and an Insurance RM (userType INSURANCE_RM, corporate email, platform password), including FLS.

The workforce app calls only workforce-access-bff. A session is created only after a successful login OTP. Internal operations are called by the BFF with X-Internal-Service-Key.

Partner Keycloak OIDC (UC-02) is a separate ceremony and is not in this epic.

Source: docs/platform/authentication-authorization/stories/README.md

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S01 Issue the login CSRF token
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As a Bank RM or Insurance RM on the web app, I need a CSRF token before any login POST, so that another site cannot submit the login journey with my browser cookies.

GET /api/v1/auth/csrf on workforce-access-bff. No session. No downstream call.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given the web app has not signed in
  When it calls GET /api/v1/auth/csrf
  Then the response is 200 with headerName and token
  And the response sets cookie WORKFORCE-XSRF

AC2
  Given a web POST to /api/v1/auth/** without X-XSRF-TOKEN
  When the BFF checks CSRF
  Then Spring Security refuses the request
  And the problem+json code CSRF_REJECTED is not implemented yet

AC3
  Given a request that already carries X-Session-Handle or Authorization Bearer
  When CSRF is evaluated
  Then CSRF is skipped for that request

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S02 Issue a single-use login captcha
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As a Bank RM or Insurance RM, I need a single-use captcha before sign-in, unlock, or forgot password, so that a script cannot spend a password or an unlock attempt without solving it.

POST /api/v1/auth/captcha. In-process on the BFF. No session is created.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given a caller with a valid CSRF token on web
  When they POST /api/v1/auth/captcha
  Then outcome is CAPTCHA with captchaId, display, and expiresInSeconds 300

AC2
  Given a captcha that is wrong, expired, missing, or already used
  When it is presented to login, unlock, or forgot-password
  Then the response is MESSAGE VAL-004
  And the password is not checked and the failure counter does not move

AC3
  Given a captcha that matched
  When the same captchaId is presented again
  Then it is rejected as already used

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S03 Sign in with captcha and password
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As a Bank RM or Insurance RM, I need to submit my login id and password with a captcha, so that a correct credential starts a login OTP and no session exists until that OTP is verified.

POST /api/v1/auth/login.

| User | userType | Login ID | Password checked by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank RM | BANK_RM | Employee ID | S13 AD-verify, then S14 |
| Insurance RM | INSURANCE_RM | Corporate email | S15 platform hash |

Body: clientType, userType, loginId, password, captchaId, captchaValue.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given a READY Bank RM and a matching captcha
  When AD-verify accepts the network password and the directory account is active
  Then outcome is OTP_SENT with challengeId, maskedMobile, and maskedEmail
  And no WORKFORCE_SESSION cookie and no sessionHandle are set

AC2
  Given a READY Insurance RM and a matching captcha
  When the platform password matches and is inside 60 days
  Then outcome is OTP_SENT
  And no AD-verify call is made

AC3
  Given captcha failure, unknown id, first login, inactive, or a lock
  When login is submitted
  Then outcome is MESSAGE with VAL-004, VAL-005, VAL-006, VAL-012, VAL-007, VAL-010, or VAL-011
  And the password is not counted when the stop is before the password check

AC4
  Given a wrong password on a READY account
  When the attempt is the first, second, or third
  Then the message is VAL-008, VAL-009, or VAL-010
  And the third failure locks the account as PASSWORD

AC5
  Given an Insurance RM whose password matches and password_changed_at plus 60 days is not after now
  When login is submitted
  Then outcome is PASSWORD_EXPIRED with an expiry ticket
  And the failure counter does not move and no OTP is sent

AC6
  Given a body that still uses IAM-001 fields without the BRD fields
  When login is submitted
  Then the response is 422 VALIDATION_ERROR

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S04 Verify a workforce OTP challenge
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As a Bank RM or Insurance RM, I need to submit the one-time code for the challenge I was given, so that login opens a session and every other purpose finishes without a session.

POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify with challengeId and otp. One operation for purposes LOGIN, UNLOCK, FORGOT, and EXPIRY.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given a LOGIN challenge whose six digits match and are inside 10 minutes
  When the caller verifies it
  Then outcome is AUTHENTICATED
  And WEB receives Set-Cookie WORKFORCE_SESSION (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite Strict)
  And NATIVE receives sessionHandle and no cookie
  And the body contains no OAuth token
  And a second verify of the same challenge is VAL-015

AC2
  Given an UNLOCK challenge that matches
  When the caller verifies it
  Then a Bank RM who was first-time receives COMPLETED and no session
  And an Insurance RM who was first-time receives CONTINUATION purpose FIRST_TIME and a reset token
  And a locked user receives COMPLETED and no session

AC3
  Given a FORGOT or EXPIRY challenge that matches
  When the caller verifies it
  Then outcome is CONTINUATION with a single-use reset token
  And no session is created

AC4
  Given a wrong code with attempts left
  When the caller verifies it
  Then the response is VAL-014 and the challenge remains

AC5
  Given the fifth wrong code
  When the caller verifies it
  Then the response is VAL-016, the challenge is deleted, and the account is unchanged

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S05 Resend an OTP without resetting attempts
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As a Bank RM or Insurance RM waiting on an OTP, I need to ask for a new code, so that I can finish the challenge without resetting the attempts I already used.

POST /api/v1/auth/otp/resend with challengeId. Same operation for every OTP purpose.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given a live challenge younger than 2 minutes
  When the caller resends
  Then outcome is WAIT with resendAvailableInSeconds
  And the current code still verifies

AC2
  Given a live challenge at least 2 minutes old and fewer than 3 resends used
  When the caller resends
  Then outcome is OTP_SENT
  And the previous code no longer verifies
  And attempts used are unchanged

AC3
  Given three resends already used
  When the caller resends again
  Then the response is VAL-017 and the challenge is deleted

Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S08 Send the OTP after Insurance RM password expiry
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As an Insurance RM whose platform password has expired, I need to ask for an OTP with the expiry ticket from sign-in, so that a code is sent only after I choose to continue.

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S09 Set or reset an Insurance RM platform password
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
As an Insurance RM continuing from first-time unlock, forgot password, or expiry, I need to submit a new platform password and its confirmation, so that the next sign-in uses that password and this call does not open a session.

POST /api/v1/auth/password with resetToken, newPassword, confirmPassword. The token's purpose is FIRST_TIME, FORGOT, or EXPIRY. Bank RM has no set-password step.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given a single-use reset token inside 10 minutes and a password that passes every rule
  When set-password is submitted
  Then outcome is PASSWORD_SET
  And no session cookie or sessionHandle is returned
  And the next sign-in must still pass captcha, password, and a login OTP

AC2
  Given new and confirm differ
  When set-password is submitted
  Then the response is VAL-019 and the hash is unchanged

AC3
  Given the new value is exactly 123456, outside 8–16 characters, contains whitespace, contains the registered email, or misses uppercase, lowercase, digit, or a non-alphanumeric character
  When set-password is submitted
  Then the first failing rule is returned and the hash is unchanged

AC4
  Given the new password matches the current hash
  When set-password is submitted
  Then the response is VAL-020

AC5
  Given purpose FORGOT while the account is locked
  When set-password is submitted
  Then the response is FORGOT_LOCKED and the hash is unchanged

Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S12 Preview the account before a password is counted
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
The BFF needs the account route before it checks a password, so that an unknown, inactive, first-time, or locked user is stopped without incrementing the failure counter.

This operation is not called by the app. The BFF calls it with X-Internal-Service-Key.
A missing or unknown key is 401 UNAUTHORIZED. The privilege is LOGIN_ORCHESTRATE except where the story says otherwise.

POST /internal/v1/login/preview on identity-authorization-service. Body: userType, loginId. Bank RM is sent as BANK_EMPLOYEE. Insurance RM is sent as INSURER_REPRESENTATIVE.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given no business_user for the login id
  When preview is called
  Then the route is UNKNOWN

AC2
  Given a user who is not active, except a pending first-time Insurance RM
  When preview is called
  Then the route is INACTIVE

AC3
  Given first_login is true
  When preview is called
  Then the route is FIRST_TIME
  And a later password check is not started by this call

AC4
  Given a password lock
  When preview is called
  Then the route is LOCKED_PASSWORD

AC5
  Given the later of last successful login and lock_cleared_at plus 30 days is not after now

  Then the account locks as INACTIVITY and the route is LOCKED_INACTIVITY

AC6

  When preview is called
  Then the route is READY

Summary: WS2-LOGIN-S14 Record the Bank RM directory password result
Epic Name: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Epic Link: Bank RM and Insurance RM authentication
Description:
The BFF needs to record whether AD-verify accepted the Bank RM, so that the failure counter and the password lock live on the business user and the network password is not stored.

This operation is not called by the app. The BFF calls it with X-Internal-Service-Key.
A missing or unknown key is 401 UNAUTHORIZED. The privilege is LOGIN_ORCHESTRATE except where the story says otherwise.

POST /internal/v1/login/bank-password-result. Body: businessUserId, accepted.

Acceptance criteria

AC1
  Given AD-verify returned authenticated true and accountActive true
  When this operation is called with accepted true
  Then the route stays READY and the failure counter is not incremented

AC2
  Given AD-verify returned authenticated false
  When this operation is called with accepted false
  Then the counter increments

AC3
  Given the account is already password-locked
  When a later correct directory password is reported
  Then the lock is not cleared and another failure is not added

AC4
  Given the directory account was inactive
  When the BFF handles that result
  Then this operation is not called
